Its tags are 노선, 지하철노선, 지하철정보, 역명, 외국어 지하철역명. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
